# getctag of the home set and of each collection (TECHNIK 5.4): equal
# while nothing changes, and then the home set's PROPFIND answers from RAM
# without opening the volume (disk sleep: an iPhone asks every 15
# minutes). Every PUT, DELETE and PROPPATCH moves both.
@seed calendar privat 2F0E6A64-1B7C-4E5A-9C1D-6A8E0B3D4C21.ics weekly-team.ics
@seed contacts kontakte A5B7C9D1-E3F5-4789-9ABC-DEF012345678.vcf erika.vcf
# As after a restart: RAM knows nothing yet.
@volume disk1

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:C="http://calendarserver.org/ns/"><A:prop><C:getctag/><A:sync-token/><A:displayname/><A:resourcetype/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< volume-opens +
< save home prop /caldav/alex/calendars/ cs:getctag
< save privat prop /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ cs:getctag

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:C="http://calendarserver.org/ns/"><A:prop><C:getctag/><A:sync-token/><A:displayname/><A:resourcetype/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< volume-opens 0
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/ cs:getctag {saved:home}
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ cs:getctag {saved:privat}

# The collection itself and a sync without changes need no disk either.
> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< volume-opens 0

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token/><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< volume-opens 0

> PROPFIND /carddav/alex/addressbooks/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:C="http://calendarserver.org/ns/"><A:prop><C:getctag/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< save book prop /carddav/alex/addressbooks/kontakte/ cs:getctag

> PROPFIND /carddav/alex/addressbooks/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:C="http://calendarserver.org/ns/"><A:prop><C:getctag/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< volume-opens 0
< value /carddav/alex/addressbooks/kontakte/ cs:getctag {saved:book}

# PUT moves both ctags.
> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar
> If-None-Match: *
> Body: dentist.ics
< status 201

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:C="http://calendarserver.org/ns/"><A:prop><C:getctag/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< volume-opens 0
< value-not /caldav/alex/calendars/ cs:getctag {saved:home}
< value-not /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ cs:getctag {saved:privat}
< save home prop /caldav/alex/calendars/ cs:getctag
< save privat prop /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ cs:getctag

# A PUT of the same bytes changes nothing.
> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar
> Body: dentist.ics
< status 204

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:C="http://calendarserver.org/ns/"><A:prop><C:getctag/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/ cs:getctag {saved:home}
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ cs:getctag {saved:privat}

# DELETE moves both.
> DELETE /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 204

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:C="http://calendarserver.org/ns/"><A:prop><C:getctag/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< value-not /caldav/alex/calendars/ cs:getctag {saved:home}
< value-not /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ cs:getctag {saved:privat}
< save home prop /caldav/alex/calendars/ cs:getctag
< save privat prop /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ cs:getctag

# PROPPATCH moves both.
> PROPPATCH /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propertyupdate xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:set><A:prop><A:displayname>Zuhause</A:displayname></A:prop></A:set></A:propertyupdate>
< status 207

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:C="http://calendarserver.org/ns/"><A:prop><C:getctag/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< value-not /caldav/alex/calendars/ cs:getctag {saved:home}
< value-not /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ cs:getctag {saved:privat}
< save home prop /caldav/alex/calendars/ cs:getctag

# A new calendar moves the home set's ctag.
> MKCALENDAR /caldav/alex/calendars/arbeit/
> Auth: alex
< status 201

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 0
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:C="http://calendarserver.org/ns/"><A:prop><C:getctag/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< volume-opens 0
< value-not /caldav/alex/calendars/ cs:getctag {saved:home}
